definitions.explanation: a document issued by schools showing a student's grades and evaluations for each subject

examples.japanese: {通知表|つうちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
{通知表|つうちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Show the report card to my parents.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通知表|つうちひょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっていた→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My grades had improved on this term's report card.

notes:
USAGE:
Handed to pupils at the end of each term (⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧), usually on the last day before a vacation. Elementary schools typically grade each subject in three levels (よくできる / ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ / もうすこし); junior and senior high schools use a five-point scale. It also records attendance and the homeroom teacher's comments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通信簿|つうしんぼ}→通信簿：19506_tsuushinbo⟧: an older name for the same document, still widely used
- ⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧: grade report — the general term, also used at universities and cram schools
- {内申書|ないしんしょ}: the confidential school record sent to high schools for admissions; students do not see it
